apps.localizedDescription: Private signed ARM32 adaptation of the Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 WARP app for Sony Android TV. Adds a landscape dashboard, remote D-pad/OK switch activation, TV launcher, and registration recovery. VPN connection still requires Android approval and device testing.

versions.localizedDescription: Private owner-maintained WARP TV 6.38.11-tv.4 ARM32 build. Remote OK connection callback fix, TV dashboard and registration recovery. Signer and SHA-256 verified. Access requires a fine-grained GitHub token with Contents: Read-only for the private release repo.
versions.changelog: Remote OK callback dispatch fixed; landscape TV dashboard, Sony remote controls, TV launcher and registration recovery. Private GitHub Release download through authenticated EmberTV.
